args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version in the 2.x line.

## Testing

CI passed on branch `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` (run `ci-0001`).

## Reviewer

Requesting review from @alex.
